stories.title: Lackawanna County issues Code Blue Alert for Tuesday night, Wednesday morning
stories.summary: The Code Blue Alert will be in effect Tuesday night through Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Repairs underway on water main break in Scranton
stories.summary: A 16-inch main broke early Monday morning.

stories.title: Dozens affected by water main break in Moosic
stories.summary: A 6-inch main broke near Rocky Glen Road in Moosic around 6 a.m. Monday.

stories.title: Four million lights and a whole lot of holiday magic
stories.summary: Stone Hedge’s Festival of Lights returns for its 10th year with more than four million lights, a dazzling drive-through display and holiday fun for the whole family!

stories.title: Black Scranton Project partners with NEPA Fashion Week to host second-ever Black Excellence Gala
stories.summary: Stormtracker 16 Meteorologist Jeremy Lewan was the recipient of this year's "Excellence in Media" award.

stories.title: Inaugural Bailey Hollow Book Festival brings local authors together
stories.summary: Over 30 local authors attended the festival, with guests being able to enjoy book signings, live readings, and meet-and-greets.

stories.title: Santa visits children with special needs at the Sensitive Santa event in Pittston
stories.summary: Sensitive Santa brings holiday joy to Luzerne County's special needs community, offering a sensory-friendly Santa experience at Coffee Inclusive in Pittston.

stories.title: Veterans honored with free brunch in Luzerne County
stories.summary: The brunch, hosted by District Attorney Samuel Sanguedolce gave veterans a free meal as a way to honor their service and sacrifice.

stories.title: Two churches in Luzerne County partner together to prepare Thanksgiving meals for families in need
stories.summary: First Baptist Church and Holy Mother of Sorrows Church came together to make 1,300 Thanksgiving dinners for their community.

stories.title: University of Scranton students team up for the 22nd annual Thanksgiving feed-a-family initiative
stories.summary: The initiative is a partnership with the University of Scranton's Center for Service and Social Justice, Friends of the Poor, and the Catherine McAuley Center.

stories.title: Man killed in deadly Carbon County fire identified three months later
stories.summary: The Carbon County Coroner's Office has identified the person killed as a 58-year-old man from Franklin Township.

stories.title: Firearm bear season underway in Pennsylvania
stories.summary: Statewide firearms bear season runs Saturday through Tuesday, November 24th.
